newsitem.title: USA: La Quinta sees recurring net $0.28/shr.
newsitem.headline: La Quinta sees recurring net $0.28/shr.

text.p: La Quinta Inns Inc said on Friday that recurring net earnings for the third quarter were $22.6 million, or $0.28 per share.
Net earnings after charges were $20.5 million or $0.25 per share, the company said.

Recurring net earnings were before a non-cash provision of $3.1 million for premature asset retirement relating to a room rennovation program and for an extraordinary item of $165,000 for debt prepayment fees, the company said.
The company will report results the week of October 21.
